senses.gloss: 1. अहो (instead of अहा [= अ॑हर्] in comp. before the letter र्).

2. अहो ind. a particle (implying joyful or painful surprise) Ah! (of enjoyment or satisfaction) Oh! (of fatigue, discontent, compassion, sorrow, regret) Alas! Ah! (of praise, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 40 seq.) Bravo! (of reproach) Fie! (of calling, Kum. iii, 20) Ho! Halo! (of contempt) Pshaw! Often combined with other particles of similar signification, as अहो धिक् or धिग् अहो, अहो बत, &c.
आ॑हो ind. (g. चादि, Pāṇ. i, 4, 57) an interjection, of asking and of doubt, ‘Is it so?’, ŚBr.; TUp.; Śak.; Bhag.
अहो—रत्न n. = अहर्-मणि above, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 68, Kāś.
अहो-रत्न &c. See अ॑हर्.
अहो—रथन्तर n., Pāṇ. viii, 2, 68 Comm.

अहो—रात्र॑ m. [pl. VS.; du., AV. & PBr.; sg. or pl., MBh. &c.] or n. [pl. RV. x, 190, 2; VS. &c.; du., AV.; VS. &c.; sg. or du. or pl., Mn.; MBh. &c.] = अहर्-निश (q.v.), a day and night, νυχθήμερον, (having twenty-four hours or thirty Muhūrtas);
अहो-रात्र॑ See ib.
अहो—रात्रम् (अम्), ind. day and night, continually, L.
अहो—रूप n., Pāṇ. viii, 2, 68 Comm.
अहो-रूप See ib.
अहो—पुरुषिका f. for आहो-पुर्˚, q.v., L.
अहो-पुरुषिका &c. See 2. अहो.
आहो—पुरुषिका f. (g. मयूर-व्यंसकादि, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 72) boasting of one's manliness or military prowess
vaunting of one's power, Bhaṭṭ.
अहो—बल m. N. of a commentator
N. of a place.
अहो-बल m. N. of various authors (also with शास्त्रिन् or सूरि), Cat.
अहो—वीर्य m. N. of a man, MBh. xii, 8900.
अहो-वीर्य See 2. अहो.
अ॑-होतृ mfn. not sacrificing, not competent to sacrifice, AV. ix, 6, 52; ŚBr.
अ॑-होम m. no oblation, ŚBr. xii.
आहो—स्वित् ind. an interrogative particle (often after किम्, e.g. किम् ईश्वरानपेक्षिकम् आहो स्विद् ईश्वरापेक्षम्, ‘is it independent of God or dependent on God?’)
